name: handoff-terminal
description: When the Claude desktop app won't type your passwords, personal data, API keys or payment details, a terminal Claude Code session does that step and the app carries on.

scope.title: What the terminal session may do
scope.description: all: sign in, fill in personal data, API keys and payment details, pay, buy and create accounts (paying, buying and creating accounts only when you asked in your own words). sign-in: only sign in.

launcher.title: Launcher (optional)
launcher.description: Program that starts the terminal session. It gets <folder> <name> <first message>. Empty = the bundled bin/handoff-launch (tmux + claude --remote-control).

notes_file.title: Setup notes file (optional)
notes_file.description: Markdown file with your own instructions for the terminal session: which password manager CLI and which browser to use. Empty = ~/.config/handoff-terminal/notes.md
